name: InferenceTimeEstimator
description: Predict inference time using fitted linear model and store it as an attribute.

configStructure.name: totalExperts
configStructure.description: Total number of experts (0 or empty = auto-count Experts under the selected node).

configStructure.name: activeExperts
configStructure.description: Number of experts activated for this inference.

configStructure.name: outputAttributeName
configStructure.description: Attribute name to store the predicted inference time on the selected node.
